content: sqlite-vec + WAL: WAL works with vec0 virtual tables and is the recommended fix - llama-stack PR #5442 added PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL + busy_timeout=5000 to sqlite-vec connections to fix 'database is locked' under concurrent workers; sqlite-vec itself added WAL concurrency tests by v0.1.10-alpha.2. Historical: vec0 had multi-connection locking bugs (issue #40, statements not finalized across transactions, fixed 0.0.1-alpha.37) - keep sqlite-vec current and wrap vec0 inserts in explicit transactions. sqlite.org WAL caveats: no network filesystem (shared-memory wal-index requires same host), cannot open read-only WAL DBs, pre-3.7.0 SQLite cannot open WAL DB at all ('file is encrypted or not a database'), page_size immutable in WAL, checkpoint starvation with permanently-active readers.
